extracted.intended_audience: Researchers/proposers submitting to NSF Directorate for Geosciences, specifically the Division of Ocean Sciences (OCE)
extracted.subtask_description: Policy guidance on resubmitting proposals that have been declined by NSF Geosciences divisions (with specific language for the Division of Ocean Sciences). Covers timing, revision expectations, exceptions, and discouragement of repeated unsuccessful resubmissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: One-year resubmission waiting period (EAR & OCE)
rubrics_metrics.description: If your EAR proposal has been declined, you cannot resubmit it for one year from the original submission date. If your OCE proposal has been declined, you generally cannot resubmit it for one year from the original submission date.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After that period, you must substantially revise your proposal to resubmit it to be reconsidered. For OCE the language is 'generally cannot resubmit for one year' leaving room for exceptions (see exception criterion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Substantial revision requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: After the one-year period, you must substantially revise your proposal to resubmit it for reconsideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If your proposal has not been substantially revised, it will be returned without review per guidelines in the PAPPG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Return without review per PAPPG for non-revised resubmissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposals that are resubmitted without substantial revision will be returned without review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This follows the Proposal & Award Policies & Procedures Guide (PAPPG); the Division will apply that guidance when determining whether a resubmission has been substantially revised.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exception for special, time-sensitive circumstances (OCE)
rubrics_metrics.description: OCE recognizes there could be special, time-sensitive circumstances where they may ask you to resubmit a revised proposal within a year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If such a circumstance applies, OCE will promptly contact the proposer to request a resubmission within the one-year period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discouragement of repeated unsuccessful resubmissions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Division discourages resubmitting proposals that have been submitted twice or more and have not shown to be competitive for support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: They will follow the PAPPG and will communicate their preferred way to implement the policy in their recommendation for declined proposals.
